etymology_chain.definition: present active infinitive of fīdō ( “ to trust; to put confidence in ” )

definitions.text_mt: Jemmen li xi ħadd huwa onest, affidabbli u veritier.
Jagħti xi ħaġa importanti lil xi ħadd biex iħaresha u jieħu ħsiebha.
Ma jagħtix kas jew attenzjoni biżżejjed għal dak li qed jagħmel.

usage_examples.en: If you trust in me, you will not regret it.

usage_examples.mt: Afda l-ġwejjed tiegħu lil sieħbu qabel siefer.
usage_examples.en: He entrusted his belongings to his friend before travelling.
Do not trust everyone you meet.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwa xi post, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni; jindika l-konfini ta’ spazju.

usage_examples.en: The book is in a bag by the door.
He lives in a big house near the sea.

definitions.text_en: props (items placed on a stage to create a scene)
definitions.text_mt: Oġġetti mqiegħda fuq palċisġeniku biex joħolqu xenarju u jżejnu l-ispettaklu.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fabbiżonju fuq il-palk kien jinkludi siġġu u mejda.
usage_examples.en: The props on the stage included a chair and a table.

usage_examples.mt: F’daqqa waħda, il-fabbiżonju waqa’ waqt l-ispettaklu.
usage_examples.en: Suddenly, one of the props fell down during the performance.

definitions.text_mt: Ġentili, edukat u pjaċevoli fl-imġiba ma’ ħaddieħor.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġar il-ġdid huwa raġel fabbli ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The new neighbour is a very affable man.

usage_examples.mt: B’daqshekk fabbli, ma setgħux ma jħobbuhx.
usage_examples.en: He was so affable that they could not help but like him.

definitions.text_mt: Bini jew faċilità kbira fejn isiru prodotti permezz ta’ makkinarju u ħaddiema.

usage_examples.en: The new factory opens next week.
He works in a clothing factory outside the city.

definitions.text_mt: Li jista’ jsir jew jiġi prodott permezz ta’ proċess industrijali.

usage_examples.mt: Dan id-disinn huwa fabbrikabbli bi prezz baxx.
usage_examples.en: This design is manufacturable at a low cost.
The new material is easily manufacturable.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew kumpanija li tipproduċi oġġetti bl-imnut permezz ta’ makkinarju.

usage_examples.en: The car manufacturer announced a new model.

usage_examples.mt: Bħala fabbrikant, irid jiżgura l-kwalità tal-prodotti.
usage_examples.en: As a manufacturer, he must ensure the quality of the products.

definitions.text_mt: Il-proċess ta’ produzzjoni ta’ oġġetti permezz ta’ makkinarju u ħaddiema.

usage_examples.en: The manufacturing of steel is a complex process.

usage_examples.mt: Għadna kemm bdejna l-fabbrikazzjoni tal-prodott il-ġdid.
usage_examples.en: We have just started the manufacturing of the new product.

definitions.text_mt: Bini jew faċilità kbira fejn isiru prodotti permezz ta’ makkinarju u ħaddiema.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-fabrika tipproduċi ħafna prodotti tal-ikel.
usage_examples.en: This factory produces many food products.
He opened a new factory in the industrial zone.

etymology_chain.definition: present active infinitive of fīdō ( “ to trust; to put confidence in ” )

definitions.text_mt: Jemmen li xi ħadd huwa onest, affidabbli u veritier.
Jagħti xi ħaġa importanti lil xi ħadd biex iħaresha u jieħu ħsiebha.
Ma jagħtix kas jew attenzjoni biżżejjed għal dak li qed jagħmel.

usage_examples.mt: Fada f’Alla u ma qtux qalbu.
usage_examples.en: He trusted in God and did not lose heart.

usage_examples.mt: Fada lil bintu ma’ oħtu meta kellu jivvjaġġa.
usage_examples.en: He entrusted his daughter to his sister when he had to travel.

definitions.text_mt: Dħul finanzjarju li jibqa’ wara li jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż u t-taxxi.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fadal ta’ din is-sena kien tajjeb ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The profit of this year was very good.
He invests all the profit in a new business.

definitions.text_en: to be left over, remain as a rest or surplus
definitions.text_mt: Jibqa’ wara li jittieħed, jintuża jew jitqassam il-bqija.

usage_examples.en: A little bread was left on the table.
If there is money left over, we will buy a gift.

etymology_chain.definition: inflection of offōcō: present active infinitive second-person singular present passive imperative / indicative

definitions.text_mt: Jagħfas il-ġerżuma ta’ xi ħadd biex iwaqqfu milli jieħu n-nifs.

usage_examples.mt: Faga lill-għadu sakemm tilef minn sensih.
usage_examples.en: He choked the enemy until he lost consciousness.
He almost strangled himself with the cable.

definitions.text_mt: Tip ta’ mina tal-art antikwata li tisplodi meta timxi fuqha.

usage_examples.en: The soldiers discovered a fougasse hidden in the road.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żona kienet mimlija fagozzi u nases oħra.
usage_examples.en: The area was full of fougasses and other traps.

definitions.text_mt: Attività li persuna tagħmel biex taqla’ l-għajxien jew timla’ l-ħin.

usage_examples.en: His occupation is farming.
What is your occupation?

definitions.text_mt: Iwettaq xi azzjoni, kompitu jew attività.

usage_examples.en: Everyone must do their part in the work.
He did this task with great care.

definitions.text_mt: Jitfa’ xi ħaġa b’saħħa u vjolenza.

definitions.text_en: to throw about (questions, queries or words, e.g. swearwords)
definitions.text_mt: Jgħid kliem spjaċevoli jew offensiv b’rabja lejn xi ħadd.

usage_examples.en: He hurled the ball far away with force.

usage_examples.mt: Beda jfajjar kliem iebes lejn il-ġurnalisti.
usage_examples.en: He started hurling harsh words at the journalists.

definitions.text_mt: Għodda tal-kartolerija użata biex iżżomm dokumenti flimkien b’mod organizzat.
Ġabra ta’ dokumenti u informazzjoni organizzati taħt kategorija waħda.

usage_examples.en: Put the documents in the file on the shelf.
I need a new file for the correspondence.

usage_examples.mt: Ftaħ fajl elettroniku għal kull klijent.
usage_examples.en: Open an electronic file for each client.

definitions.text_mt: Iżomm stampa jew informazzjoni fil-memorja u jsejjaħha lura meta jkollu bżonn.

usage_examples.mt: Fakar fil-ġrajjiet ta’ żmien twil ilu.
usage_examples.en: He remembered the events of long ago.

definitions.text_mt: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiftakar xi ħaġa li kien insejha.

usage_examples.en: I reminded him to buy the milk.
His voice reminded me of my father.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tbigħ il-frott u l-ħxejjex f’ħanut jew fis-suq.
Persuna li ġġorr tagħbija għal ħaddieħor bi ħlas, speċjalment fl-ajruporti.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fakkin tal-ħaxix għandu frott frisk illum.
usage_examples.en: The greengrocer has fresh fruit today.
The luggage was carried by a porter at the airport.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fakkin fi Triq ir-Repubblika jbigħ l-aqwa tadam.
usage_examples.en: The greengrocer in Republic Street sells the best tomatoes.

etymology_chain.definition: an individual employed to do all sorts of duties

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tagħmel varjetà kbira ta’ xogħlijiet u ħidmiet differenti.

usage_examples.mt: Jaħdem bħala faktotu fl-uffiċċju u jagħmel kollox.
usage_examples.en: He works as a factotum in the office and does everything.

etymology_chain.definition: an individual employed to do all sorts of duties

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tagħmel varjetà kbira ta’ xogħlijiet u ħidmiet differenti.

usage_examples.mt: Il-faktotum tal-lukanda jieħu ħsieb il-bżonnijiet kollha tal-mistednin.
usage_examples.en: The hotel factotum takes care of all the guests’ needs.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna bżonn faktotum li jaf jagħmel kollox.
usage_examples.en: We need a factotum who knows how to do everything.

definitions.text_mt: Divizjoni akkademika ta’ università li tispeċjalizza f’qasam partikolari ta’ studju.

usage_examples.en: The Faculty of Languages is located next to the university.
He enrolled in the Faculty of Medicine a year ago.

definitions.text_mt: Għasfur tal-priża żgħir li jtajjar malajr ħafna u jiekol insetti u għasafar żgħar.

usage_examples.mt: Il-falkett huwa għasfur tal-priża rari f’Malta.
usage_examples.en: The Eurasian hobby is a rare bird of prey in Malta.
We saw a Eurasian hobby flying over the fields.
